The '''Eriadu Manufacturing Shipyards''' were the facilities operated by [[Eriadu Manufacturing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. The shipyards were situated near [[Phelar Port/Legends|Phelar Port]], alongside the eastern banks of the [[Phelar Floe]]. The shipyards' main product was civilian [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] and interstellar craft.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Description==
The shipyards were considered to be on par with the [[Sluis Van Shipyards|shipyards]] at [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], roughly generating the same output capacity. Although the Eriadu Manufacturing Shipyards were not as impressive as the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] or the [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] shipyards, the Eriadu Manufacturing Shipyards were still a financially viable interest and had become well-known for their high-quality production.<ref name="GatORW" />

The Eriadu Manufacturing Shipyards was financed by members of [[House Valorum/Legends|House Valorum]]. The shipyards were divided into several primary facilities: the administrative offices located atop [[Ja Knoll]], and the manufacturing facilities located close to the [[Bay of Conquest]]. Major thoroughfare routes connected the shipyards to central [[Phelar Port/Legends|Phelar Port]], while most of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu's]] heavy industries were conducted in [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]]. Millions of laborers were employed by Eriadu Manufacturing to work in the foundries and assembly lines. Although [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] was outlawed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the law was not enforced in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Thus, nearly half of the laborers at the shipyards were slaves. This practice continued after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] encouraged the enslavement of non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="GatORW" />
